feed.title: Donegal Group CEO Kevin Gerard Burke Exercises 24,000 Options and Sells Shares on September 11, 2026
feed.summary: Donegal Group Inc.'s President and CEO, Kevin Gerard Burke, exercised 24,000 stock options at $14.39 per share and simultaneously sold all 24,000 shares at $19.226 per share on September 11, 2026. Following these transactions, Burke directly holds 13,870 shares of Class A Common Stock and indirectly holds 3,342 shares through a 401(k) Plan. This series of transactions reduced his derivative options position from 24,000 to zero.

feed.title: Donegal Mutual Insurance buys $1.05m of Donegal Group stock By Investing.com
feed.summary: Donegal Mutual Insurance Co., a significant owner of Donegal Group Inc. (NASDAQ:DGICA), recently purchased 54,725 shares of the company's Class A common stock for over $1 million. This insider transaction occurred on September 11, 2026, with shares bought in two blocks at prices between $19.226 and $19.254. The purchase comes as Donegal Group reported a 32% increase in its second-quarter profit, driven by lower weather-related losses and stronger investment income.

feed.title: Verizon Wireless, T-Mobile resolve lawsuits over ad campaigns
feed.summary: Verizon Wireless and T-Mobile have settled lawsuits accusing each other of misleading consumers with advertising campaigns that promised significant savings from switching cellphone carriers. The dismissal of Verizon's lawsuit and T-Mobile's countersuit was filed in Manhattan federal court after a preliminary injunction favored Verizon. The settlement reportedly included discussions about a framework to resolve similar future advertising disputes.

feed.title: Kimberly-Clark preps for asset sale tied to $48B Kenvue purchase
feed.summary: Kimberly-Clark may need to sell off some assets to gain regulatory approval for its $48.7 billion acquisition of Kenvue, the maker of Tylenol. The deal has already been approved in Australia, and the European Commission is currently reviewing it. The article also touches upon the potential timeline for the deal's closure and related news about Kenvue's job cuts prior to the acquisition.

feed.title: Netflix Climbs 4%, Alphabet Ticks Up, Amazon Barely Budges as New Streaming Policy Alliance Launches
feed.summary: Netflix stock surged 4% after the company co-founded the Streaming Access and Choice Alliance, aiming to challenge the antitrust exemption that currently prevents it from bidding on live sports rights. While Netflix sees significant potential upside from this policy shift for its advertising ambitions and content offerings, Amazon barely moved and Alphabet gained only 3%, reflecting the relatively minor impact on their core businesses compared to Netflix's subscription streaming focus. The alliance initiates a long-term lobbying effort, with investors watching for regulatory actions from the Justice Department and FCC regarding the Sports Broadcasting Act.

feed.title: 'They Don't Call It an Extra Value Meal for Nothing': McDonald's Pitches $8 Big Macs as Diesel Hits $6.23
feed.summary: McDonald's is promoting an $8 Big Mac meal to attract customers while facing record-high diesel prices, which are driving up supply chain costs for franchisees. This strategy collides with McDonald's Q2 FY2026 earnings showing decelerated global comparable sales and negative U.S. guest counts, leading to a 14% year-to-date stock drop. CEO Chris Kempczinski admitted to execution issues and a slow recovery, noting that about a third of locations didn't follow value pricing recommendations.

feed.title: Enlight Renewable Energy (NASDAQ:ENLT) Insider Sells 4,329 Shares of Stock
feed.summary: Enlight Renewable Energy insider Amit Paz sold 4,329 shares of ENLT stock for approximately $331,472, reducing his ownership by 1.52%. The stock is currently trading below its 50- and 200-day moving averages and has a high price-to-earnings ratio, with analysts giving it an average "Hold" rating despite some "Buy" recommendations.

feed.title: Southwest Airlines launches sale with up to 40% off fares
feed.summary: Southwest Airlines has launched its "Week of WOW" sale, offering up to 40% off base fares for flights between October 5, 2026, and March 3, 2027. The promotion also includes discounts on rental cars through Enterprise and hotel stays, along with savings on Getaways vacation packages. Customers must book flights by September 17, 2026, with a 21-day advance purchase.

feed.title: Bank of America expects investment banking fees to fall 10% By Investing.com
feed.summary: Bank of America anticipates a decline in its third-quarter investment banking fees, projecting them to fall by at least 10% to between $1.6 billion and $1.8 billion, down from $2 billion last year. CEO Brian Moynihan attributed this expected decline to broader market conditions, noting that the overall investment banking market is down by about 10%. Moynihan also mentioned that consumer credit quality remains strong, with affordability being a key concern for consumers, while the sales and trading division is expected to see flat results year-over-year.

feed.title: MEDITECH Expanse EHR Live Across First Full U.S. Divisions of HCA Healthcare
feed.summary: MEDITECH has successfully implemented its Expanse electronic health record (EHR) platform across 34 hospitals in HCA Healthcare’s Capital and North Florida divisions. This marks the first two full U.S. divisions of HCA Healthcare to adopt the platform, bringing the total number of HCA hospitals using Expanse in the U.S. and U.K. to 72. The cloud-based system aims to enhance workflow efficiencies, care coordination, and data-driven decision-making for clinicians.

feed.title: Ramnik Bajaj – Senior Vice President & Chief Data Officer
feed.summary: Ramnik Bajaj is the Senior Vice President and Chief Data Officer at Delta Air Lines, leading the Enterprise Data and AI Office to advance the company's data and AI strategy. He is responsible for data governance, development, and management to support analytics, machine learning, and generative AI initiatives. Bajaj previously held similar leadership roles at USAA and Wells Fargo Bank, and was a Partner at Deloitte Consulting LLP, bringing over 20 years of experience in driving business value through data and AI solutions.

feed.title: Form 8K Curtiss-Wright Corp For: 14 September By Investing.com
feed.summary: The article is a financial filing notification from Investing.com, announcing a Form 8K filing for Curtiss-Wright Corp on September 14. It includes a brief mention of the company's stock performance and is primarily a news item about the regulatory filing.

feed.title: Should You Buy Costco Stock Before Sept. 24?
feed.summary: Shares of Costco Wholesale have only risen 6% this year, underperforming the S&P 500. The company is set to release its Q4 earnings on September 24, which will wrap up its fiscal year and provide guidance for the next. However, the author advises against buying Costco stock due to its high valuation of nearly 50 times trailing earnings, suggesting that despite its strong business performance, it is overpriced and unlikely to see a significant surge after earnings.

feed.title: Wendy Short Bartie Integrates Patient Advocacy and Public Trust into Bristol Myers Squibb Business Strategy
feed.summary: Wendy Short Bartie of Bristol Myers Squibb is redefining corporate affairs by embedding patient advocacy, public trust, and healthcare access directly into the company’s core business strategy. This approach treats corporate reputation as a valuable asset that drives operational success and engagement within the healthcare ecosystem. By aligning external relations with patient-centered outcomes, Bartie aims to bridge the gap between corporate objectives and community needs, establishing institutional trust as a measurable factor for long-term growth.

feed.title: Traders Purchase High Volume of Put Options on Best Buy (NYSE:BBY)
feed.summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) recently saw unusual options trading activity with investors purchasing 9,418 put options, a 40% increase over the average. Analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with a consensus price target of $85.40, despite recent positive earnings results where the company beat EPS and revenue estimates and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.96. Insider selling and institutional investor activity have also been noted, with the stock trading at $93.28 with a market cap of $19.56 billion.

feed.title: Judge Dismisses Suit Alleging Alexandria Misled Investors Over Portfolio Strength
feed.summary: A California judge has dismissed a class-action lawsuit against Alexandria Real Estate Equities, which accused the company and its executives of misleading investors about its financial health and the strength of its lab building portfolio. The lawsuit, filed after Alexandria posted significant impairment charges, alleged securities fraud due to misrepresentations about market conditions in the life sciences sector. The judge sided with Alexandria, ruling that the company's explanation was more cogent and compelling, although the plaintiff could refile to address identified deficiencies.

feed.title: PNC at Barclays conference: growth, AI and branch push By Investing.com
feed.summary: PNC Financial Services Group outlined its strategy at the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference, focusing on organic growth, local market expansion, and significant investment in technology, particularly AI. The bank expects net interest income to rise over 15% in 2026 and net interest margin to exceed 3%, driven by resilient consumers, strong commercial demand, and successful integration of FirstBank. Management also detailed aggressive branch expansion plans and an in-house approach to AI development, aiming for substantial productivity improvements while carefully managing risks.

feed.title: Scholar Rock shares: TD Cowen keeps buy on FDA approval, broad label
feed.summary: TD Cowen maintained a buy rating and $71 price target for Scholar Rock (NASDAQ:SRRK) after the FDA approved its drug Isembyld for spinal muscular atrophy patients aged two and older. The approval includes a broad label without restrictions, and TD Cowen projects significant sales, with peak U.S. sales of $2.3 billion in 2035. Other analysts like Truist Securities, Raymond James, BMO Capital, and H.C. Wainwright also reiterated positive ratings and price targets, highlighting strong analyst sentiment despite the stock being considered overvalued relative to its fair value by InvestingPro.

feed.title: Carriage Services (NYSE:CSV) Hits New 1-Year Low - Should You Sell?
feed.summary: Carriage Services (NYSE:CSV) shares recently hit a new 52-week low of $32.00 after disappointing quarterly results missed analyst expectations. Despite mixed analyst ratings and a consensus "Hold" rating with a $51.00 price target, the company continues to pay a $0.45 annualized dividend, yielding about 1.4%. Institutional investors maintain significant holdings, with BlackRock Inc. and Vanguard Group Inc. increasing their stakes.

feed.title: Vita Coco (NASDAQ:COCO) Stock Price Up 5.5% - What's Next?
feed.summary: Vita Coco (NASDAQ:COCO) shares saw a 5.5% increase, reaching $54.86, despite trading volume being 79% below average. The company surpassed quarterly expectations, reporting $0.82 EPS against a $0.56 estimate and revenues of $216.15 million, a 28.1% year-over-year increase.

feed.title: PNC at Barclays conference: growth, AI and branch push By Investing.com
feed.summary: PNC Financial Services Group Inc. presented its strategy at the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference, focusing on organic growth, local market expansion, and significant investment in technology and AI. The bank reported strong performance with unchanged 2026 guidance, expecting net interest income to rise over 15% and net interest margin to exceed 3%. PNC is also expanding its branch network, aiming for 7% market share in new markets, and is implementing AI across various operations to enhance productivity and efficiency.

feed.title: Intel Upgraded, CVS Health Downgraded: Updated Rankings on Top Blue-Chip Stocks
feed.summary: Louis Navellier has provided updated Stock Grader recommendations for 93 blue-chip stocks, based on institutional buying pressure and fundamental health. Key upgrades include Intel (INTC) from Strong to Very Strong, while CVS Health (CVS) was downgraded from Very Strong to Strong. The article details comprehensive lists of upgrades and downgrades across various rating categories.

feed.title: Citizens Bank accuses SoFi of poaching 30 mortgage employees
feed.summary: Citizens Bank has filed a lawsuit against SoFi, alleging that the digital lender poached 30 of its mortgage-focused employees since 2024, impacting business in nine states. The lawsuit highlights two specific incidents: the mass resignation of nine Connecticut-based employees in June and the departure of 12 employees from its Texas mortgage department in August 2024. Citizens Bank claims SoFi "strategically orchestrated" these resignations, calling it a "pattern of racketeering activity," while SoFi dismisses the allegations as baseless and an attempt to prevent employees from seeking other career opportunities.

feed.title: Nvidia, Palantir Pull Back From Anthropic Models Over Fears AI Could Expose Corporate Secrets
feed.summary: Nvidia, Palantir, and Booz Allen Hamilton are reportedly restricting their use of advanced AI models from companies like Anthropic and OpenAI due to concerns that these models could retain or learn from sensitive corporate data and proprietary knowledge. Nvidia and Palantir are developing an alternative system using Palantir software and Nvidia's open Nemotron models for supply chain analysis, allowing companies to customize models with their own data while maintaining control. Anthropic is responding to these concerns by implementing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which will store activity data in customer-controlled cloud infrastructure to address data retention issues, though these concerns have not impacted expectations for its IPO.

feed.title: Match Group (NASDAQ:MTCH) Reaches New 12-Month High - Here's What Happened
feed.summary: Match Group (NASDAQ:MTCH) shares recently hit a new 52-week high, trading up to $43.53, surpassing the average analyst target price of $42.46. Despite a "Moderate Buy" rating from MarketBeat and mixed analyst opinions, the company exceeded earnings expectations with an EPS of $0.70, though revenue slightly missed forecasts. Match Group also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share, while institutional investors hold a significant majority of the stock.

feed.title: Caterpillar Falls 4% While Deere Edges Higher: Is the Data Center Power Trade Unwinding?
feed.summary: Caterpillar's stock fell 4% due to concerns about the AI data center power trade unwinding, despite its large backlog. In contrast, Deere & Company rose 1% as it lacks exposure to the AI sector, and Paccar remained largely unchanged. The decline in Caterpillar's stock appears to be a momentum unwind rather than a fundamental shift in demand, prompted by recent warnings from AI executives about slowing the pace of AI development.

feed.title: Schwab partners with Anthropic to bring AI tool to advisors
feed.summary: Schwab Advisor Services is collaborating with Anthropic to introduce "Claude for Financial Advisors," an AI tool designed for over 16,000 independent registered investment advisors. This new offering aims to streamline tasks such as meeting preparation, financial planning updates, analytics, and client communications by integrating with existing advisor technology platforms. Schwab is the first RIA custodian to incorporate this tool, which emphasizes enhancing advisor-client relationships through improved efficiency and service.

feed.title: Eagle Materials (NYSE:EXP) Given New $207.00 Price Target at DA Davidson
feed.summary: DA Davidson has lowered its price target for Eagle Materials (NYSE:EXP) to $207.00 from $220.00, while maintaining a "neutral" rating. This new target suggests a potential upside of approximately 12.7% from the previous closing price. The construction company recently reported quarterly earnings that missed EPS estimates, although revenue exceeded expectations and increased year-over-year.

feed.title: Corbus Pharmaceuticals Shares Rise 12% After CANYON-1 Obesity Trial Data
feed.summary: Corbus Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:CRBP) shares rose 12% following positive topline results from its CANYON-1 Phase 1b clinical trial for CRB-913, an obesity treatment. The study showed statistically significant mean weight loss across all tested doses, with the highest 60 mg dose resulting in 5.0% weight loss at week 12. CRB-913 also demonstrated good tolerability, with Corbus planning to discuss further clinical development with the FDA and initiate a Phase 2 trial in early 2027.

feed.title: Superior officers find graffiti after fire at Enbridge, Inc. building
feed.summary: A fire broke out early Monday at an Enbridge, Inc. building in Superior, Wisconsin, near Great Lakes Elementary School. Firefighters quickly extinguished the blaze, and no injuries were reported. However, officers discovered graffiti on the building and signs, with one message reading, "Ashes you shall be Enbridge…". Enbridge stated that most staff had moved out, and the building was in the process of being sold to Superior Learning Academy, expressing full support for the prosecution of those responsible.

feed.title: Judge sets date for Colgate toothpaste tube recyclability trial
feed.summary: A federal judge has scheduled a trial for April 10, 2028, in a class-action lawsuit against Colgate-Palmolive concerning "misleading" recyclability claims on its toothpaste tubes. The lawsuit, initiated by three consumers in California, alleges that the company's "recyclable tube" labeling was deceptive given that local MRFs do not accept such tubes. Attorneys for the plaintiffs intend to subpoena waste management companies like WM and Republic Services for additional information as the discovery period continues.

feed.title: Cullinan Oncology stock rating reaffirmed at Buy by TD Cowen
feed.summary: TD Cowen has reiterated a Buy rating on Cullinan Oncology (NASDAQ:CGEM), projecting peak sales of $225 million for its drug, with potential for $1 billion based on REZILIENT3 trial results. The drug's new application is under FDA review with a PDUFA date in February, and there's optimism for approval for both first-line and second-line treatments by the first half of 2027. Cullinan Oncology has also reported positive Phase 3 results for zipalertinib and positive FDA feedback for CLN-049, indicating continued progress in its therapeutic pipeline.

feed.title: Coda Octopus Group Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
feed.summary: Coda Octopus Group reported solid Q3 2026 results with revenue up 9.2% to $7.7 million and pre-tax income up 16% to $1.8 million, driven by strong performance in Defense Engineering Services and Acoustic Sensors and Materials, despite challenges in Marine Technology due to geopolitical instability. The company highlighted advancements in DAVD and NANO technology adoption, including U.S. Navy authorization for DAVD, and maintained a strong financial position with $31.7 million in cash and no debt. They continue to pursue organic growth, expand defense programs, and evaluate strategic M&A opportunities.

feed.title: Ceva and LG Partner to Advance UWB Integration for Automotive and IoT SoCs
feed.summary: Ceva and LG Electronics have partnered to create a comprehensive ultra-wideband (UWB) technology platform aimed at accelerating the development of UWB-enabled automotive, industrial, and consumer System-on-Chips (SoCs). This collaboration combines Ceva's UWB baseband IP and software with LG's UWB radio-frequency technology, designed to reduce engineering effort and integration risks for customers. The platform supports advanced UWB standards and is expected to drive significant growth in UWB device shipments across various applications.

feed.title: Cellectis quits CAR-T and pivots to ‘in vivo’ gene editing
feed.summary: Cellectis has decided to abandon its donor-derived CAR-T cell therapy programs, citing a material change in the commercial and clinical landscape for treating blood cancers. The company will now focus its resources on "in vivo" gene editing medicines targeting cardiovascular disease, specifically two preclinical programs, HEAL-101 and HEAL-201. This strategic shift has led to a significant drop in Cellectis's share price, as it moves away from clinical-stage assets to therapies that have not yet been tested in humans.

feed.title: EvolveWare Recognized in the Inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for AI-Augmented Code Modernization Tools
feed.summary: EvolveWare has been recognized as a Niche Player in Gartner's inaugural 2026 Magic Quadrant for AI-Augmented Code Modernization Tools. The company's Intellisys Platform is highlighted for its unique approach to understanding legacy systems before modernization and its robust data privacy features, particularly important for regulated industries. EvolveWare's CEO, Miten Marfatia, emphasized their commitment to comprehensive system understanding, customized deliverables, and safeguarding client intellectual property, attributes they believe led to this recognition.

feed.title: DA Davidson Reaffirms "Buy" Rating for Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA)
feed.summary: DA Davidson has reaffirmed its "Buy" rating for Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA), setting a price target of $625, indicating a potential upside of approximately 14%. Despite some recent target reductions from other firms, Ulta Beauty maintains a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating among analysts with an average price target of $624.57. The company recently surpassed quarterly earnings and revenue estimates, reporting $6.55 EPS on $3.04 billion in revenue.

feed.title: Options Surge Sends ServiceNow Stock Into Rally Mode
feed.summary: ServiceNow (TSE:NOWS) stock is rallying due to a surge in call options, indicating increased investor confidence in its potential for upside. While there's still demand for protective put contracts, the overall sentiment points to bullish expectations, balanced by a mindful approach to potential market volatility. This unusual options activity suggests that investors anticipate positive developments for the company.

feed.title: Anthropic's AI Warning Is 'Noise' in a 'Secular Bull Market:' Bank of America Says
feed.summary: Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya dismisses recent AI safety concerns raised by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, as well as OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk, as "noise" in a "secular bull market" for AI. Arya argues that geopolitical and commercial competition will prevent any real slowdown in AI development, projecting annual AI capital spending to exceed $3 trillion by 2030. Despite a recent correction, semiconductor stocks remain undervalued given their high growth rates and utilization of infrastructure.

feed.title: ExxonMobil releases more than 54,000 pounds of unauthorized air pollution at Baytown refinery
feed.summary: ExxonMobil's Baytown refinery released over 54,000 pounds of unauthorized carbon monoxide due to a boiler malfunction on September 8. This incident contributes to air quality issues in the Houston region, which already struggles to meet federal ozone standards. Environmental group Air Alliance Houston noted that the Baytown facility has a history of significant unauthorized emissions and permit violations.

feed.title: Pfizer Says Major Headwinds Are Easing as Pipeline, Obesity Plans Take Center Stage
feed.summary: Pfizer is reportedly seeing major headwinds ease, having addressed tariff and pricing concerns, cut costs by $7.2 billion, and exceeded revenue and earnings despite lower COVID-19 demand. The company is now focusing on new products, selective acquisitions in early-stage assets, particularly in China, and pipeline catalysts centered on oncology and obesity treatments, including GLP-1 therapies. CEO Albert Bourla highlighted the shifting investor focus from past challenges to future growth opportunities in its pipeline.

feed.title: Netflix Stock (NFLX) Climbs as It Joins Amazon and Google to Launch New Streaming Coalition
feed.summary: Netflix (NFLX) shares rose 4% after the company, alongside Amazon and Google's YouTube, launched the Streaming Access and Choice Alliance (SACA) to advocate for innovation-friendly streaming policies. This rally was further supported by Evercore upgrading Netflix to a Buy rating and increasing its price target to $110, citing opportunities in live events. The move comes as Netflix seeks to sustain audience engagement amidst concerns about long-term interest.

feed.summary: Netflix, Inc. A live video interview with co-CEOs, CFO, and VP of Finance/IR & Corporate Development will follow at 1:45 p.m. Pacific Time on the Netflix Investor Relations YouTube channel, addressing questions from sell-side analysts.

feed.title: Nvidia and other chipmakers suffer as AI warnings raise spending concerns
feed.summary: Shares of Nvidia, Micron Technology, and Broadcom declined following calls by AI developers to slow down AI development, which raised concerns about future hardware spending. While some analysts believe AI adoption remains strong, others are cautious about demand for data centers if training activity slows, and Broadcom's revenue outlook also contributed to investor caution.

feed.title: Abbott to pay $384 mln over contaminated infant formula allegations, US Justice Dept says
feed.summary: Abbott Laboratories has agreed to pay over $384 million to settle allegations related to contaminated infant formula, as announced by the U.S. Justice Department. This settlement addresses concerns regarding the safety of their infant formula products. The details were reported by Reuters on September 14, 2026.
